caption: A pair of skis slides over an exposed rock, and sparks flash from their metal edges.

sa.check: A pair of skis on snow.
The skis slide over an exposed rock.
Sparks flash from their metal edges.
The sparks come at the rock, not on the snow.
The scrape comes first and the sparks follow.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only while the edges cross the rock and are gone at once; none appear while the skis are on snow.
pc.fail: Sparks flash while the skis are on snow with no rock beneath; or continue after the skis have left the rock; or a spark stays lit on the rock; or the edges glow along their length.

pc.expect: Two skis throughout; the sparks leave nothing behind on the rock or the snow.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the rock after the skis have passed; or a ski vanishes or a third appears; or the rock vanishes or appears from nowhere; or the skis merge into one.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fall to the snow and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the skis; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the snow for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The skis slide on in the direction of travel over the rock; the sparks flick out behind the edges.
pc.fail: The skis stop dead on the rock and then continue; or leap into the air off the rock; or the sparks fly ahead of the skis; or the skis slide uphill by themselves.

pc.expect: The skis pass over the rock's surface; they pass through neither the rock nor the snow's surface; the skis keep their shape.
pc.fail: A ski passes through the rock; or sinks through the snow as if through air; or a ski bends double; or the rock passes through a ski.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The skis' colours, the snow and the rock stay the same.
pc.fail: A ski changes colour or length; or the snow changes colour; or the rock changes shape.

note: The skier, if in view, is kept because the skis are under them; skiing form is not judged.
